caption: Morning trek through the rice terraces of Tetebatu with Mount Rinjani standing tall behind the green fields.
caption_id: Trek pagi menyusuri pematang sawah terasering Tetebatu dengan latar megah Gunung Rinjani di kejauhan.

caption: Refreshing dip at Jeruk Manis waterfall after a 45-minute jungle walk from Tetebatu village.
caption_id: Segarnya berenang di air terjun Jeruk Manis setelah 45 menit trekking menembus rimbunnya hutan tropis.

caption: Learning traditional bamboo weaving with an artisan family in Loyok village, a craft that has been passed down for generations.
caption_id: Belajar menganyam bambu tradisional bersama keluarga pengrajin di desa Loyok, warisan turun-temurun lintas generasi.

caption: Sunset views from the southern coast after a full day exploring the Tetebatu highlands.
caption_id: Pemandangan matahari terbenam yang syahdu setelah seharian penuh menjelajahi dataran tinggi Tetebatu.
